MERIDIAN.note: Past producers write it in free text: SALT LAKE, SLBM, SALT LAKE., SALTLAKE and SALT LAKE BASE MERIDIAN all mean the Salt Lake meridian. One record says SALT WASH, which is not a survey meridian (Salt Wash is a member of the Morrison Formation).
